answer: Identities are hashed into reputation islands. Each island may broadcast one aggregated signal per epoch, signed by a random quorum of its members and void outside it. Quotas are paid per island from the shared settlement oasis, never per identity, so packing one island with puppets still earns one share. An attacker wanting N shares must open N islands: each costs a burned, non-refundable fee and a cross-audit that voids the island when a quorum of members reply with identical timing fingerprints. Cost grows linearly in N with no bulk discount; honest users open one island once.
